Cristiano Ronaldo has retired from international football following a fall-out with Portugal boss Jorge Jesus.

The 41-year-old is Portugal's leading goalscorer having scored 146 times in 234 appearances. In 2016, he won the European Championship with Portugal. [...] The Portuguese federation released a statement expressing "deep gratitude and immense admiration" for Ronaldo's service to the country.

On Thursday, a day before Portugal's next squad for the upcoming Nations League fixtures is due to be announced, Ronaldo confirmed his retirement from international duty via social media.
